status: source-checked production register; not runtime integration
notes: M1-C IDs extend local research without silently redefining team F IDs. Crosswalk covers only the supported subset of each broad team fact.

claims.claim: Eagle Crater visual context uses PIA05755, sols 58 and 60.
claims.qualification: Approximate true color; panorama, not surveyed game geometry.

claims.claim: McKittrick abrasion was 45.5 mm across and 4.4 mm deep.
claims.qualification: Target-specific dimensions; 3-second interaction is fictional time compression.

claims.claim: Use about 4 mm as the spherule reference diameter.
claims.qualification: Approximate average, not uniform measured size of all grains.

claims.claim: Berry Bowl comparison used brushing; no grinding was needed.
claims.qualification: Separate observation from abrasion. Compare cluster and clean substrate; no single-bead instant mineral scan.

claims.claim: Embedded concretions and rock textures contribute evidence for ancient wet conditions.
claims.qualification: Interpretation of evidence. Water sequence is reconstruction, not footage or eyewitness history.

claims.claim: Hard spherules could obstruct the RAT; Flatrock documents an interrupted sequence.
claims.qualification: Do not assert McKittrick had the same stall or add fictional permanent damage.

claims.claim: Both MER rovers carried RAT; Spirit used it on Adirondack for the first Mars grind.
claims.qualification: GRIND is an educational skill link, not a capability transferred between physical robots.

claims.claim: Dust coverage can decrease through cleaning.
claims.qualification: 2014 comparison supports separate dust/wear parameters, not early-2004 dust amount.
